description_en: Saves the test results of an API
description_zh: 该接口用于保存API测试的结果
name: SaveDataServiceApiTestResult

parameters.help_en: The API ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174012.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: API的ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/174012.html接口获取
parameters.name: api_id

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID。您可以登录DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The sample success response of the API. This parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: 非必填参数，API测试成功的结果示例
parameters.name: result_sample

parameters.example: {"apiLog": null, "data": null, "errCode": 1108110622, "errMsg": "data Source query failed", "requestId": "0 bc14a **** 5902762031 ****"}
parameters.help_en: The sample failure response of the API. This parameter is optional
parameters.help_zh: 非必填参数，API测试失败的结果示例
parameters.name: fail_result_sample

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use the test results generated by the system. If you do not configure the resultSample or failResultSample parameter, the test results generated by the system are used
parameters.help_zh: 是否使用系统自动生成结果，如果不传resultSample/failResultSample参数，则使用系统默认生成的
parameters.name: auto_generate

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the test results are saved
Data.description_zh: 是否成功保存测试结果

RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，一次请求的唯一标识

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
